# Tangkhul Lexical Line Entries
kathum (num.) : three; triad
mati (num.) : four; quadruplet
p hanga (num.) : five
ningkazing (noun) : peace; quietness; tranquility
kapha (adj.) : good; virtuous; fine
ngathum (verb) : to conceal; to hide secretly
kong (noun) : river; stream; brook
won (noun) : flower; blossom
bing (part.) : plural marker for persons and animate beings
li (part.) : locative case suffix; at; in; to
